findings.summary: PSBTv0 unknown key 0x0f is preserved using version context.
All four official Dash BIP67 vectors match.
Independent cosigner origin paths are preserved.
Nonzero BIP44 accounts are labeled custom and require matching signer material.
Purpose48 remains a wallet-specific convention, not a Dash Core standard.
CLI exports include network flags and complete active ranged-wallet setup.
Dash P2SH and Bitcoin P2WSH use wrapper-specific signer-count limits.
